answer.rationale: Incumbent already refused a price reopen, so renew or negotiate cannot hit the 18% spend cut. The primary contract ends in 14 days with no auto-renew; deferral would drop supply into a 94% loaded line with no buffer. The low-cost quote meets the mandate alone; c2 reports a prior primary move with quick onboarding and clean invoicing, which is the only inherited path that jointly addresses cost and continuity. c1 still implies migration is not risk-free, so this is not a broad unguarded rollout and c2 should be verified before commit. Adding a second source would not replace the expiring primary contract in one decision.
